objective:
Beat the conjectures.io Exact integer kernels thumbv6m (Cortex-M0+) board, verified locally only. Do NOT register a hotkey, sign, run miner/submit.py, submit, or spend TAO.

Context: prior IMD goal 245c10e6-494e-43f3-a3bf-bc67925b46dd (public repo https://github.com/identity-md-launches/goal-3465-objective-build-entry-c-conjectures-io at c5e3f91274b1f0c409127e8cfc14aa5ac8f392da) made 0 takeovers: its only change tied or lost to former champion 50. Its lessons: 20 of 39 items went to packaging, 9 to re-scoring old champions, only 8 single micro-changes, and every one added instructions on the common path. This goal fixes that: no re-baselining of 37/42/46/48, no offline-replay packaging, all effort on Thumb speed and size.

Base for every item: https://github.com/identity-md-launches/goal-3465-objective-build-entry-c-conjectures-io/blob/c5e3f91274b1f0c409127e8cfc14aa5ac8f392da/eik-work/baselines/former-50/entry.c (sha256 88617bb49e36a06cabd7d84ce6fe504ee337f8f41ad7c55bc72f696db94060c3). Kit: https://github.com/conjectures-io/exact-integer-kernels-miner at 5a32428ad4aa23bce737d50a738ace24ddeeed2e, measurement fingerprint 2c8fd1f3a6711f0639685319fb25262b02bfecf4c6589c52cb58928270a46322. If python -m eik setup fails, reuse the prior repo's eik-work/toolkit setup.

Target and threshold: reigning thumbv6m champion 53 is withheld but scored 0.9684x former 50 on the validator's inputs, so a takeover needs S_thumbv6m <= 0.97 x 0.9684 = 0.939x former 50. Internal goal: <= 0.935x former 50 on every seed, for margin. Former 50 thumbv6m: S 40.43, bytes 20,500 (size factor 1.146), typical means sigmoid 37.7, tanh 37.6, exp 42.9; wide 28.9/20.2/34.3; hard 49.9/79.3/55.6. Score math (lnS): 1 KiB of code+tables = 0.58%; one instruction off one function's typical mean = 0.183/mean (about 0.45%); wide = 0.1/mean.

Rules (RULES.md in the kit is the authority): one C11 file, eik_sigmoid/eik_tanh/eik_exp on binary32 words, correctly rounded nearest-even on all 2^32 inputs incl. NaN payload quieting and signed zeros; integer only; no #include or other directives beyond #define/#undef/#if family; no predefined-macro dependence (keep the existing EIK_SEL wide-char selector; Thumb uses the t_ paths); no long, plain char, attributes, pragmas, volatile, function pointers, recursion or mutable statics; <=64 KiB code+tables, <=8 KiB stack per target; renamed copies are rejected.

Edit only Thumb-selected code and tables so the RV32IM object stays byte-identical. Shared measurement seeds for all items: 1001, 2002, 3003. Held-out seeds for integration only: 4004, 5005, 6006. Every result needs per-class numbers, a diff against the base, and full-domain checks of changed functions. Mark anything unchecked UNVERIFIED. If nothing reaches the threshold, deliver the best combined entry, its ratios and the next steps.
